_validation.builtBy: Claude, 21-Sep-2026 (rebuilt after the transaction-direction fix, F189)
_validation.basis: CAMS and KFintech transaction exports ONLY. Direction of every row is taken from the SIGN of the units the registrar recorded, never from the wording of the description.

verifiedAgainst.document: Consolidated Account Statement (CAS), ISIN level, NAV date 18-Sep-2026, registrars CAMS + KFINTECH
verifiedAgainst.unitBalances: Every fund on the CAS reconciles to this file to three decimals, including the ones the CAS reports at 0.000 units.
verifiedAgainst.note: The statement check below covers the registrar-sourced rows only. This file now also carries one manual purchase of 25-Sep-2026, and this fund’s NAV seed has moved to that date while the other funds still carry 18-Sep-2026 seeds until the app refreshes them.

_validation.correctedInThisBuild: The previous build read a transaction’s direction from its description. "Merger", "Merger To TATA Equity Opportunities Fund" and "Online Lateral Out" all carry NEGATIVE units, and all three were booked as purchases, so units that had left the folio were added instead of subtracted — twice over. That invented 12,127.818 units of Tata Mid Cap, 9,779.952 of Tata Service Industries and 8,356.668 of UTI Dividend Yield Direct, three funds fully exited years ago, and overstated the portfolio by about Rs 1.06 Cr. All three now correctly close at zero and the file no longer needs any fund switched off to reach the right total.
_validation.reinvestmentHandling: Every IDCW reinvestment carries its amount AND units as the registrar recorded it, so reinvested units have a cost basis and reinvested money is not counted as income received.
_validation.valueResearchComparison: 18 of 41 held funds also match the Value Research holdings statement exactly. The rest differ because that statement is built from a hand-typed history; the CAS agrees with THIS file, not with it, in every one of those cases.
_validation.notes: Balances are chain-computed per scheme+folio from the registrar rows. Scheme codes carried over from the previous portfolio where the fund name matches; anything still pending resolves on the first NAV refresh.

manualAdditions.navSource: AMFI via mfapi.in, scheme code 148053, NAV date 25-Sep-2026
manualAdditions.note: Not from a registrar statement. Units are the full Rs 7,00,000 divided by the 25-Sep-2026 NAV; if the registrar allots on an amount net of stamp duty, replace this row when the CAMS statement shows it.
